mentions.name: Plot Along
mentions.description: This app is a mapping tool for planning motorcycle rides, usable for personal ride planning or collaboratively with groups. It offers live cursors (like Figma), an elevation chart with grade overlay, and QR-code enabled collaboration links to make in-person sharing simple. It is built with a Mapbox frontend on a monolithic Cloudflare Worker, with fully automated CI/CD running roughly 4000 unit tests and over 300 e2e tests; Claude implemented nearly the entire codebase, managed via a self-hosted Gitea project with milestones and issues. An Android app is in Play Store review for early access testers.
mentions.problem: Existing mapping apps were too slow and cumbersome for planning motorcycle rides, both for the author alone and with groups.
mentions.audience: Motorcycle riders and pleasure & sport drivers planning rides for themselves and with groups.
mentions.source_excerpt: I wanted a faster, easier mapping app to plan motorcycle rides for myself and with groups, so I finally bit the bullet and started building my own at the beginning of this year.
